name: Web & API traffic
description: Edge (nginx) and application (api) tiers: status mix, hot routes, and latency

panels.title: Avg API latency (ms)
panels.query: cairnobs.metrics!=true cairnobs.heartbeat!=true service=api | stats avg(latency_ms) as avg_latency_ms

panels.title: Edge responses by status
panels.query: cairnobs.metrics!=true cairnobs.heartbeat!=true service=nginx | stats count by status | sort -count

panels.title: Busiest routes
panels.query: cairnobs.metrics!=true cairnobs.heartbeat!=true service=nginx | stats count by route | sort -count | head 10

panels.title: Status by edge host
panels.query: cairnobs.metrics!=true cairnobs.heartbeat!=true service=nginx | stats count by host, status

panels.title: Slowest API routes (avg ms)
panels.query: cairnobs.metrics!=true cairnobs.heartbeat!=true service=api | stats avg(latency_ms) as avg_latency_ms by route | sort -avg_latency_ms | head 10

panels.title: Slow API requests (>800ms)
panels.query: service=api | where latency_ms>800 | sort -timestamp | head 50 | fields timestamp, host, route, status, latency_ms, trace_id
